parityRules: Every production image object added to RU must be added to the matching EN entry in the same pass.
src/source identity, asset identity and sourceIds must match across locales where the project validator requires parity.
RU alt/caption stay Russian; EN alt/caption must be faithful English translations, not copied Russian text.
Fields marked *NeedsTranslation are editorial prompts only and must not be copied verbatim into EN production.
